description: List upcoming US federal tax deadlines for a filer type (individual, self_employed, s_corp, partnership, employer) from a date in 2026 or 2027, or check what is due on a given date. Covers Form 1040 and extensions, quarterly estimated payments, S-corp and partnership returns, Form 2553, W-2, 1099-NEC, 940 and 941. Dates already moved for weekends and legal holidays, each with its official source. Calendar-year filers; no state deadlines.

count.description: How many deadlines to return, 1 to 20. Default 5.

date.description: List deadlines on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD (2026 or 2027). Default today, US Eastern time. To check one date, pass it and read whether the first row falls on it.

filer_type.description: Whose deadlines: individual (Form 1040 filers), self_employed (freelancers, sole proprietors, single-member LLCs), s_corp, partnership (multi-member LLCs), employer (payroll forms), or all. Default all.

name: tax_deadline
title: Federal tax deadlines
